verses.ya-rabbi-hab-liya-sabran-asta-inu-bihi-c: yā rabbi hab liyā ṣabrā ʾastaʿīnu bihi ʿalā ḥtimāli ʾadhā l-ʾakhlāqi yā ṣamadu
wal-ʿafwa ʿanhum ʾilahī maʿ muṣābarati wakaẓmi ghayẓi kamā ʾaḥbabta yā faradu
waqalla minhum muwaffī l-ʿahdi muḥsinahu lakin ʿawāqibu ṣabri dūnahā sh-shahadu
ḥamlu l-ʾadhā sunnatu lil-ʾanbiyāʾi maʿā kun ḥāmilā kulla khayri ṣāḥibī tajidu
lā taftaḥi l-ʿayna lil-ʾaswāʾi ḥaythu ʾatat wal-ʿaynu tathrībuhā fī dhāka qad yaridu
mā mithlu l-ʾighḍāʾi ʿan ʾaswāʾihim ʾadabu ʾatmim lanā ʾabadā yā wāḥidu l-ʾaḥadu
wāmlaʾa fuwādiyā nūrā ʾastanīru bihi fī layli jahliyā yā raḥmānu yā shahidu
ʾadim salāmī ʾilahī dāʾimā ʾabadā ʿalā r-rasūli lladhī min dūnihi l-waṭadu
